title: X-FACT: A New Benchmark Dataset for Multilingual Fact Checking

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating whether a model can predict a statement's veracity relying solely on the textual claim without evidence documents, comparing its performance against a majority baseline to detect if the model has learned spurious correlations from the dataset.

Measuring the cross-lingual transfer abilities of models by evaluating them on a zero-shot test set containing languages not present in the training data, in order to test if models overfit to language-specific artifacts.

Testing the models on an out-of-domain test set consisting of claims from different fact-checking sources than the training set, to assess if the models overfit to source-specific or domain-specific patterns.
